label: BFD
notes: BFD Control packet (RFC 5880 §5) over UDP port 3784 (single-hop) or 4784 (multihop), per RFC 5881; the echo variant on port 3785 carries no BFD header. The fixed 24-byte control header is modelled in full: bytes 0 and 1 are bit-packed (version/diag and state/flags) and split into masked views plus a flag bitset, followed by the detection multiplier, the length, the two discriminators and the three intervals in microseconds. When the Auth Present bit is set, an authentication section follows byte 24 and shifts the payload (the Length field counts it), so the variable tail is excluded from the fixed window. The discriminators are the natural match keys: my_discriminator identifies the sending system, your_discriminator the neighbour being tracked.

fields.label: Diagnostic
fields.description: Reason for the most recent state transition.

fields.label: State
fields.description: Session state as seen by the sender.

fields.label: Flags
fields.description: Poll/Final control handshake, the CPI, Auth Present, Demand and Multipoint bits.

fields.label: Detect Multiplier
fields.description: Detection time multiplier; the negotiated transmit interval times this value is the failure detection time.

fields.label: Length
fields.description: BFD Control packet length in bytes; 24 without authentication.

fields.label: My Discriminator
fields.description: Unique, non-zero discriminator generated by the transmitting system.

fields.label: Your Discriminator
fields.description: The neighbour's my_discriminator received earlier; 0 until learned.

fields.label: Desired Min TX Interval
fields.description: Minimum transmission interval the sender wants, in microseconds.

fields.label: Required Min RX Interval
fields.description: Minimum receive interval the sender can support, in microseconds.

fields.label: Required Min Echo RX Interval
fields.description: Minimum echo receive interval, in microseconds; 0 when the echo function is disabled.
